limitations: This is a six-job Linux primary audit at commit 80b8cce1773e4c31bf64cb6c2b7f43e8445ec3fe. Other platforms and VST3 have separate owners; metadata observed here is not their primary qualification.

Passing core CTest output suppresses unittest method stdout. The exact published 23-method product-session module was invoked and passed; per-method outcomes and zero internal skips are not independently shown in these job logs.

Native fixture jobs use dummy SDL and a synchronous substituted RtMidi API through real application entry; physical audio/MIDI, asynchronous driver races, human use/accessibility, and hardware fidelity remain separate gates.

Complete artifacts, scenario stderr files, and waveform qualification JSON were not independently downloaded. This audit verifies primary logs and their executed fail-closed archive/runtime/hash/scenario/stderr/report checks.
Existing named quarantine and local ptrace leak limitations remain; no broad suppression or newly weakened sanitizer policy is accepted.
Strict product-session completion verifies accepted record consistency. Its false execution/dispatch/semantic/product-readiness attestation flags remain unchanged.
Successful full R4 qualification does not close independent hardware, R5/R6, complete-instrument listening, or other open model/product gates.
